    total_v_span = (rows - 1) * v
    y_start = 0.5 - total_v_span / 2.0

    sum_radii = float(np.sum(radii))

    # Precompute distances between centers
    D = np.sqrt(((centers[:, None, :] - centers[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2))
    # Avoid zeros on diagonal
    np.fill_diagonal(D, 0.0)
